steps: Take a free online course on IT documentation (e.g., Google IT Support Certificate on Coursera).
Practice help-desk scenarios using a virtual lab or simulation (e.g., TryHackMe help-desk room).
Learn desktop support basics: install OS, troubleshoot hardware, use diagnostic tools (e.g., CompTIA A+ study materials).
Build a small project (e.g., a simple Python script or a personal website) to start developing developer skills.
Explore end-user support and VoIP tools (e.g., Cisco VoIP tutorials) to round out IT support expertise.
